package.json

 
{
  "name": "codepage",
  "version": "1.15.0",
  "author": "SheetJS",
  "description": "pure-JS library to handle codepages",
  "keywords": [
    "codepage",
    "iconv",
    "convert",
    "strings"
  ],
  "main": "cputils.js",
  "types": "types",
  "browser": {
    "buffer": "false"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "voc": "~1.1.0",
    "mocha": "~2.5.3",
    "blanket": "~1.2.3",
    "@sheetjs/uglify-js": "~2.7.3",
    "@types/node": "^8.0.7",
    "@types/commander": "^2.12.0",
    "dtslint": "^0.1.2",
    "typescript": "2.2.0"
  },
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git://github.com/SheetJS/js-codepage.git"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "pretest": "git submodule init && git submodule update",
    "test": "make test",
    "build": "make js",
    "lint": "make fullint",
    "dtslint": "dtslint types"
  },
  "config": {
    "blanket": {
      "pattern": "[cputils.js]"
    }
  },
  "alex": {
    "allow": [
      "chinese",
      "european",
      "german",
      "japanese",
      "latin"
    ]
  },
  "homepage": "https://sheetjs.com/",
  "files": [
    "LICENSE",
    "README.md",
    "bin",
    "bits/*.js",
    "types/index.d.ts",
    "types/*.json",
    "cptable.js",
    "cputils.js",
    "dist/sbcs.full.js",
    "dist/cpexcel.full.js"
  ],
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/SheetJS/js-codepage/issues"
  },
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=0.8"
  }
}
